newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech BICS100 bond index falls 0.005pts to 102.700.
newsitem.headline: Czech BICS100 bond index falls 0.005pts to 102.700.

text.p: The BICS 100 index measuring the Czech Republic's most liquid bonds fell 0.005 points in Friday's trading to 102.700 points, bank Ceska Sporitelna said.
It said the duration of the index portfolio rose 0.070 points to 2.856 years.

The BICSG 100 index, which Ceska Sporitelna calculates using only government bonds, rose 0.078 points to 99.764, the bank said, and the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.003 points to 2.395 years.
It said the yield index YBICS 1000 fell 0.396 points to 1,051.308.
